description: Checks up to 6 shop names against Etsy's shop name rules and whether an Etsy shop already uses each name. 'No shop found' does NOT mean available: Etsy does not reuse names of closed shops and closed shops do not show up.

names.description: Up to 6 names, as an array or a comma-separated string

name: etsy_shop_name_check
title: Etsy shop name check
